objectives: 組織的核心價值需要管理者善用財務資源才能貢獻社會，本課程旨在培育管理學院的學生學習及應用組織的各項會計資訊進行管理決策。
content:
1. (09/10) Basic concepts in accounting and managerial accounting
2. (09/17) Cost concept and cost behavior
3. (09/24) Managerial Accounting Applications in Real World Cases for ethical issues
4. (10/01) Product costing and cost accumulation in a batch production environment
5. (10/08) Industrial accounting reports for managerial accounting
6. (10/15) Process costing and hybrid product-costing systems
7. (10/22) Activity-based costing concepts, systems and management
8. (10/29) Midterm exam
9. (11/05) Cost-volume-profit analysis
10. (11/12) Absorption/variable costing
11. (11/19) Profit planning and financial planning
12. (11/26) Standard costing and profit planning and financial planning
13. (12/03) Flexible budgeting and analysis of overhead costs
14. (12/10) Responsibility accounting, operational performance measures and BSC
15. (12/17) Reflection of managerial accounting
16. (12/24) Final Term Report
books:
1.	Managerial Accounting, 15th ed., by Garrison, Noreen and Brewer, ISBN 9780078025631
2.	Managerial Accounting, 18th ed., by Garrison, Noreen and Brewer, e-Book at NCU library
grading_policy:
1.	Projects and quiz (30％)
2.	Midterm exam (35％)
3.	Final take-home (35％)
